svg.title: A stored review dimension below its flight-config floor becomes an obligation row that stands until it is disposed
svg.desc: Top lane, at base: five dimension bars from a stored review scoring 79, with durability at 5 and every other dimension at 18 or 19, and a dashed floor line at 10. Durability falls below the floor, but no code path names a dimension, so the 5 is averaged inside a total that passes. Bottom lane, at the change: the same record produces one obligation row naming the run, the reviewer's assertions, the dimension durability, its score of 5 and the floor of 10, and the total stays 79. The row retires only when one disposition from the closed set is recorded against that dimension on the stored record, folded with the dispatched node id or exempted with the recorded reason; until then it is reported beside the total, never inside it.
svg.text: A dimension below its declared floor is a row that must be disposed, and the total is never adjusted
The record drawn is the shape this plan’s own landings measured: a total of 79 with durability 5 against 18 and 19 elsewhere. The floor is declared per dimension in flight config.
